## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 9-fascicle text by [菩提流支](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%8F%A9%E6%8F%90%E6%B5%81%E6%94%AF) Bodhiruci is the Indian *śāstra* (treatise) on the *Maitreya-paripṛcchā* tradition (parent sūtra: *[Mílè pútísà suǒwèn běnyuàn jīng T0349](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0041)* by [竺法護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AB%BA%E6%B3%95%E8%AD%B7) Zhú Fǎhù). The Indic authorship is attributed to [安慧](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AE%89%E6%85%A7) *Sthiramati* or another Yogācāra-school *ācārya*; Bodhiruci's translation provides the principal Chinese textual basis for the *Maitreya-paripṛcchā* commentarial tradition.

**Abstract**

The translation belongs to [菩提流支](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%8F%A9%E6%8F%90%E6%B5%81%E6%94%AF) Bodhiruci's Northern-Wèi activity (508 – 537 CE). The 9-fascicle scope makes the work one of the most substantial Northern-Wèi *śāstra* translations.

The Taishō text (T1525) is established on the standard apparatus.
